name: jira
description: A JIRA sidebar tab listing the issues assigned to you and the active repo's project, with a "Start work" action that creates a worktree session for one - and batches, which split a pile of tickets into clusters, give each its own worktree and coding agent, track every ticket on a kanban filtered by cluster, and send review feedback back to the agent that wrote it. Backed by the Jira Cloud REST API; the API token is held in the host's per-extension secret store, never in a setting.

jira.email.description: Atlassian account email for the API token.

jira.projectKey.description: Fallback project key, when no file, map entry or variable applies.

jira.projectKeyFile.description: Repo file holding the project key.

jira.projectKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the project key.

jira.projectMap.description: Project key per repository path, as JSON.

jira.projectSettings.description: Settings overridden per Jira project, as JSON: {"CAP": {"jira.productionBranch": "main"}}. The editor below writes it.

jira.jql.description: Custom JQL for the "assigned to me" section.

jira.projectJql.description: Custom JQL for the project section, bypassing the project key.

jira.boardMaxResults.description: Issues the editor tab's board fetches per list.

jira.boardDoneDays.description: Days a finished ticket stays on the board. 0 shows no Done tickets.

jira.commentLimit.description: Comments handed to the agent with the ticket. 0 sends none.

jira.detailCacheSeconds.description: Seconds an opened ticket's details are reused before fetching again. 0 turns caching off.

jira.executionSkill.description: Which skill a cluster's agent implements tickets with, as a path - chosen with the picker below, which writes this same field. Empty uses execute-jira-ticket when it is installed; "none" leaves it to the agent. A cluster can override it in the Batches review.

jira.qaSkill.description: Which skill a cluster's agent checks its work with, as a path - chosen with the picker below, which writes this same field. Empty uses the extension's own jira-batch-qa; "none" leaves it to the agent.

jira.integrationSkill.description: Which skill the batch's QA agent merges and ships with, as a path - chosen with the picker in the Batches review, which writes this same field. Empty uses the extension's own jira-batch-merge; "none" leaves it to the agent.

jira.productionBranch.description: The branch a batch's QA branch is cut from and merged back into. Empty uses the repository's default branch (origin/HEAD).

jira.qaBranchTemplate.description: How a batch's QA branch is named - {batch} is the batch name as a slug, {date} is today as YYYYMMDD.

jira.startQaOnFirstReview.description: Start a batch's QA agent by itself the moment its first ticket reaches Review. Off, QA starts from the Start QA button.

jira.qaStatus.description: The Jira status a ticket is moved to when the batch is handed off after the production merge, matched by name.

jira.qaAssignee.description: Who handed-off tickets are assigned to: a display name, an email, or an account id. Empty leaves the assignee alone. A name matching nobody, or several people, stops the hand-off before anything is written.

jira.previewUrlTemplate.description: The URL a handed-off ticket's comment says it can be checked at, for example the store's preview-theme link. Empty leaves the URL out of the comment.

jira.reviewAction.description: What a ticket's Review button runs when clicked: a code review of its pull request, a visual QA of its preview theme, or both. Picking from the button's menu changes it.

jira.skillPaths.description: Extra places to look for skills, one per line - a directory of skills, or a single skill directory. ~/.claude/skills and the repository's .claude/skills are always searched.

jira.clusterBranchTemplate.description: Branch name for a batch cluster - {cluster} is the cluster's name as a slug.

jira.batchAnalysisTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the AI may take when it reads the codebase before grouping tickets. Needs a Perch new enough to accept it; older ones stop at 60 seconds.

jira.sendAutoSubmit.description: Submit the issue to the agent instead of letting you review it first.

jira.updateIssueOnStartWork.description: Let "Start work" move and assign the issue in Jira.

jira.inProgressStatus.description: Status "Start work" moves the issue to.

jira.showStatusBarIcon.description: Show a Jira icon in the status bar that opens the Jira editor tab.
